company: VISTA SPECIALTY HOSPITAL OF TUCSON LLC
title: Facilities Director (Plant Operations)
text:
**FACILITY DIRECTOR**

**Vista Specialty Hospital**

**Facility Director Director Job Summary:**

To plan, organize, supervise, coordinate and control the activities of the plant operations and maintenance functions which are necessary in maintaining the physical structures, HVAC, mechanical, electrical systems, utilities and grounds of this hospital in an operative and safe working condition. Maintains performance improvement activities within the department and participates in CQI activities. Assures competency of all personnel. Assists in formulating the budget. Maintains efficient and effective department operation while requiring compliance with all JCAHO, state, federal and local regulatory laws, standards and protocols.

**Education:** High School diploma or equivalent. Associate degree or equivalent from two-year college or technical school preferred. Equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may substitute for education requirements.

**Licenses/Certification:** Trade certification in electrical, plumbing, HVAC or similar field preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum three years’ related experience in a healthcare setting with some administrative and supervisory responsibility. Considerable experience in maintenance, plant operation and construction.

Safety Sensitive-Designated Position
